01

THE QUESTION问题

What needed to work?需要解决什么？

Create a lightweight visual experience that feels responsive on both mouse and touch devices.让轻量的视觉体验同时适应鼠标与触屏设备。

02

THE PROCESS方法

How it comes together.如何将它实现。

  1. Use particles to represent the bouquet and animate the blooming sequence.用粒子表达花束形态并实现绽放序列动画。
  2. Support drag rotation, wheel or pinch zoom, replay and fullscreen viewing.支持拖动旋转、滚轮或双指缩放、动画重播与全屏浏览。
03

THE OUTCOME成果

What the work shows.项目所呈现的结果。

A publicly accessible static webpage, with interaction and rendering handled in the visitor’s browser.可公开访问的静态网页，交互和渲染在访客浏览器中完成。
